selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the first truth in this passage?
questions.answer: It is about Allah’s greatness and majesty.

questions.question: What does the example of the same type of flower around the world show?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah creates in the same way everywhere on earth.

questions.question: What huge springtime job is described in the passage?
questions.answer: Caring for and organizing over two hundred thousand kinds of plants and animals.

questions.question: What big event does spring remind people of in the passage?
questions.answer: It reminds people of a great bringing-to-life and shows Allah’s power clearly.

questions.question: Why is knowing people’s hidden thoughts an especially strong proof?
questions.answer: Because it shows Allah’s knowledge reaches even what others cannot see.

questions.question: What big conclusion comes from all these works being counted as one work?
questions.answer: They all belong to one unique and strong Creator.

questions.question: Why would no sound mind accept partnership with Allah, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because it goes against His perfect power, greatness, and complete rule.

questions.question: What two things are named as the real bounds on these acts?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will.

questions.question: What alone sets the limits for those actions?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will.

questions.question: How many examples does the passage say will be given for the second truth?
questions.answer: Three examples.

questions.question: What title is given to the first truth in this passage?
questions.answer: It is called the truth of grandeur and sublimity.

questions.question: How does the passage use flowers to show unity in creation?
questions.answer: It says countless flowers of one kind are made across the whole earth in one pattern.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens to hundreds of thousands of kinds of living things in a few weeks?
questions.answer: They are managed and brought forth with care and order.

questions.question: What movement of the earth is mentioned in the first truth?
questions.answer: The earth is made to turn.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah knows at the same time as running the universe?
questions.answer: The hidden thoughts inside human hearts.

questions.question: What does that teach about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: It teaches that His rule and action are not shared with anyone.

questions.question: How does the passage describe a mind that would accept such an idea?
questions.answer: It says a sound mind would never accept it.

questions.question: Why is shirk presented as a crime against Allah’s dignity?
questions.answer: Because it attacks His glory, greatness, and majesty.

questions.question: According to the passage, who decides the bounds of those deeds?
questions.answer: Allah, through His wisdom and will.

questions.question: What are chance and natural causes compared to in relation to Allah’s power?
questions.answer: They are like an outer covering that hides His power from direct view.

questions.question: What is the first truth trying to help the reader understand about Allah?
questions.answer: It helps the reader understand Allah’s unmatched greatness and majesty.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the same Being and the faraway stars?
questions.answer: The same Being makes and runs them all together.

questions.question: How long does the passage say this spring work takes?
questions.answer: About five or six weeks.

questions.question: What does the mention of creating the heavens and earth in six days add to the discussion?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s great creative power from the beginning.
